Market today: The big news is the "vanishing gap" between big tech and the rest of the market. This suggests tech's strong run might be slowing, or other sectors are catching up, which is a direct read for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -54.92% on a leveraged product with a useless stop. SPAL is also down -60.95% and leveraged. QQQ (-3.73%) and SMH (-15.06%) are on "TRIM" status with stops very close to current prices. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the performance of your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and the immediate stops on SMH and QQQ. Also, watch for any further signs of tech's leadership fading.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management and respecting your stops, especially with leveraged products and margin.
plays: SMH: Trim if it breaks below your 540 stop. This is a critical level given its "TRIM" status and -15.06% loss.
QQQI: Sell if it breaks below your 52 stop. It's on "SELL" status and very close to that level.
SOXL: Review your SOXL position. A -54.92% loss on a leveraged, decaying ETF on "SELL" status demands immediate attention; consider a significant trim or exit.
